title: goal_questions leaves the first numbered piece unread when a lead-in precedes it, and researched's no-question message omits numbered pieces it skipped
goal: goal_questions reads the first numbered piece after a lead-in, splitting the lead-in off as its question-mark branch does, so 'Answer these: 1. does X work' then a semicolon and '2. does Y work' gives two questions, researched prints its skip lines also when every piece of the goal is unread ('Questions: 1. a 2. b'), and kb/_self/tools.md states that the skip lines print only when the goal names a question
